title: Check: History of the Periodic Table

questions.stem: Why was Mendeleev's periodic table more successful than earlier attempts?

options.text: He arranged elements by atomic number
He left gaps for undiscovered elements and predicted their properties
He only included metals in his table

questions.explanation: Mendeleev's key insight was leaving gaps for undiscovered elements and predicting their properties. When these elements were later discovered (such as germanium, which he called 'eka-silicon'), his predictions were remarkably accurate, proving his table was correct.
